messages.subject: Formatting questions -- x axis tick labels and confidence shading  around geom_smooth
parts:
Hi helpful ggplotters,

Attached is a graph which is almost perfect thanks to ggplot and
helpful listserv members, except for two things --

(1) I would like to turn off the shading that is added with
geom='smooth' (or maybe stat='smooth') and

(2) I would like to be use one out five of the ages in the x axis, so
it would run "[0,5)", then "[25,30)", etc, and include the endpoints
of [0,5) and [80,85).

Here is the plotting code:

g = ggplot() + layer(data = ratesdf, mapping = aes(x = age, y =
rate, group=group),
geom = c("point", 'smooth'), stat="identity") +
layer(data = ratesdf, mapping = aes(x = age, y = rate,
group=1), geom = "smooth", stat = "smooth") +
xlab('Age') + ylab('Rate')
print(g)

TIA!
